description: Firebase service-account credentials + RTDB vars. Replace every placeholder with your actual values from Firebase Console.
where_to_get: Firebase Console → Project Settings → Service Accounts → Generate New Private Key
notes: Save this file as 'firebase_creds.json' in the project root OR in the 'config/' folder (both are gitignored).
The private_key field must preserve the literal newline characters (\n) inside the key.
Do NOT commit firebase_creds.json with real keys.
Enable Realtime Database in Firebase Console and set rules to allow service-account access.
INDEX in RTDB rules for order_by_child queries (admin screen): { "appointments": { "appointment_date": true, "resident_id": true }, "residents": { "fingerprint_template_id": true } }
